title: Source
description: A primary or secondary document, recording, or artefact from which evidence is extracted. Sources have documented provenance, a type classification, and a quality tier.

title.description: Official title of the source document, or a descriptive title if no official one exists.

description.description: Brief description of what this source is and why it is relevant.

date.description: Date the source was created or published.

url.description: URL where the source can be accessed.

archive_url.description: Persistent archived copy URL (web.archive.org, archive.ph, etc.).

location.description: Physical or institutional location (e.g., 'National Archives, RG 272, Box 14').

quality_tier.description: Source quality tier: A=verified_primary, B=probable_primary, C=credible_secondary, D=unverified, E=disputed.

quality_tier_rationale.description: Explanation of why this quality tier was assigned.

language.description: Language of the source (ISO 639-1 code, e.g., 'en', 'fr').

classification_at_time.description: Classification level at the time of creation (e.g., 'TOP SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL', 'UNCLASSIFIED').

current_classification.description: Current classification level, if declassified or changed.
